diagnosis: Rollouts 1 and 3 passed checks C1 and C2 despite not having access to PF1. This indicates that the model is defaulting to disabling email collection and deleting test responses, which are the outcomes linked to PF1. These decisions are likely driven by a default setting or a common heuristic that prioritizes data security and privacy.
